info.title: gim-hub admin API
info.description:
Admin API of the gim hub, served only on `GIM_HUB_ADMIN_LISTEN`. Metadata only: messages are end-to-end encrypted and the API never shows who talks to whom.

Every route except POST /admin/api/login needs the `gim_admin_session` cookie; every non-GET request also needs `X-CSRF-Token` equal to the session's `csrf_token` (403 `csrf_failed`). Timestamps are integer seconds since the Unix epoch, except lode's, which are passed through from `state.json`. Every non-2xx JSON response has the shape `{"error":{"code","message"}}`.

get.description: Every `GIM_HUB_*` setting with its effective value (defaults applied). Secrets (the webhook secret, the PSK, any `*_SECRET`, `*_TOKEN` or `*_KEY` value) are redacted: `value` is `null` and `redacted` is true when one is set. File paths are shown, never file contents.
This hub's PeerID and addresses, and per peer hub (allowlisted, or known to the outbox) whether it is bound now, the queued outbox entries, delivery failures and the last connection.

200.description: The allowlist file and its entries

put.description: Validates the text with the allowlist rules, writes it atomically to `GIM_HUB_FEDERATION_ALLOWLIST` and applies it at once, as SIGHUP does. On a validation error the file is unchanged. Audited as `allowlist_update`.

422.description: Invalid allowlist; the message is the parser's (`validation_failed`)

post.description: The handle becomes free; its user keeps existing without a handle. Audited as `handle_release`.

get.description: `{"supervised":false}` unless `LODE_DIR` is set; otherwise lode's fields from `state.json` (all `null` before lode wrote it).

post.summary: Check for a newer version now
post.description: Bumps `check_nonce`; lode reports the result in `available` or `check_error`. Audited as `lode_check`.
Bumps `restart_nonce`; lode stops the hub gracefully and starts the current version again. Audited as `lode_restart`.
Sets `target` to the given version, else to lode's `last_good`. Audited as `lode_rollback` (target the chosen version).

409.description: No version given and no `last_good` recorded (`conflict`)

post.description: Sets `target` to the version or `latest`. Audited as `lode_update` (target the version).

post.summary: Log in with the admin token
post.description: Compares the token with `GIM_HUB_ADMIN_TOKEN_FILE` in constant time and sets the `gim_admin_session` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/admin, 8 h absolute). At most 5 failed logins per source IP and minute. Audited as `login_ok` or `login_failed` (never the token).

429.description: Too many failed logins from this IP (`rate_limited`)

post.description: Deletes the session and clears the cookie. Audited as `logout`.

get.description: Version, uptime, storage sizes, aggregate counts and push counters. Group data is a count only.

Returns the session of the cookie. Without one, a request from a `GIM_HUB_ADMIN_TRUSTED_PROXIES` peer carrying `GIM_HUB_ADMIN_TRUSTED_HEADER` gets a new session (actor `header:<value>`, cookie set, audited as `login_ok`).
Users by user ID, optionally filtered by a substring of the user ID or handle.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the user ID or handle.

get.summary: A user with devices and sessions
get.description: The user's devices with their unexpired sessions (by non-secret `session_ref`) and the hubs listed in the user's hosting record. Never group membership, peers or message metadata.

delete.description: Deletes every session of the device; it must sign in again. Audited as `device_sessions_revoke` (target `<user_id>/<device_id>`).

post.description: Sets the suspension, revokes every session of the user's devices and refuses new sign-ins (POST /v2/auth/challenge and /v2/auth/session answer 403 `user_suspended`). Audited as `user_suspend` with the optional reason.
The user can sign in again. Audited as `user_unsuspend`.

entries.description: Parsed entries by hub ID (the own hub is skipped).

text.description:
New file contents: one `hub_id [multiaddr ...]` per line, `#`
comments.

redacted.description: A secret is configured but not shown.

active.description: Active in the user's current DeviceList.

last_seen.description: Latest sign-in among the device's current sessions.

Error.description: Body of every non-2xx JSON response.

peer_id.description: libp2p PeerId of the runtime key.

oneOf.description: lode's fields from `state.json`; absent when not supervised.

LodeStatus.description: lode status. Only `supervised` when the hub does not run under lode.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on every non-GET request.

revision.description: Build revision, `unknown` when not built from a checkout.

last_error.description: Set while deliveries to the peer are failing.

PushCounters.description: Push dispatcher counters since the hub started.

session_ref.description:
The first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the session token;
never the token.

blob_bytes.description: Total size of the blob directory.

db_bytes.description: The database file plus its WAL.

hosting_hubs.description:
Hub IDs listed in the user's stored hosting record (empty without
one).

last_seen.description: Latest sign-in among the user's current sessions.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

adminSession.name: gim_admin_session
adminSession.description: Session cookie from POST /admin/api/login (or GET /admin/api/session behind a trusted proxy). Non-GET requests also send X-CSRF-Token.
